newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK DRAINS SKK1.0 BLN IN REV REPO TENDER.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK DRAINS SKK1.0 BLN IN REV REPO TENDER.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Thursday said it had drained funds totalling 1.0 billion crowns at this morning's overnight securities reverse repurchase tender.
It was the NBS's first successful reverse repo tender this year, with an average rate of 13.98 percent.
The NBS added all bids, which totalled one billion crowns, were accepted at the tender offering to sterilise an unspecified volume of funds.
The NBS holds tenders on a daily basis, if needed, instead of quoting securities repo and reverse repo rates.
